note: Catalog of Engine/M600 fault codes. Keyed by class:code (the same code exists in both the error and warning catalogs with different meanings). Repetitive per-target faults (lasers 1-9, tools, fans) are stored once as a family with a `target` descriptor; the resolver expands the trailing index. Regenerate from the master Google Sheet with tools/import_error_codes.py.

codes.title: Controller node unresponsive
codes.description: No 'alive' communication from the main node — the master board is not receiving alive signals from the laser board.
codes.cause: The master controller (ECU) is not receiving 'alive' confirmation from the LCU (Laser Control Unit), or the CAN bus is open / non-functional.
remediation: Check that the Laser Control Unit module is powered and supervision LEDs are active.
Ensure the firmware is loaded and updated.
Inspect the wiring between the ECU and LCU modules and replace if necessary.
Replace the LCU module.
Replace the ECU module.

codes.title: Digital output driver short circuit
codes.description: The digital output driver is short-circuited or overloaded.
codes.cause: A short circuit, or the 200mA consumption limit exceeded on one of the 8 digital outputs.
remediation: Inspect the wiring and integration for false contacts or crushed wires.

codes.title: Deploy encoder error (invalid value)
codes.description: The Z-axis encoder value is invalid, indicating an error or disconnection.
codes.cause: The ECU receives encoder values, but they are invalid.
remediation: Ensure the encoder is connected and blinking green.
Adjust the encoder position and ensure it is fully aligned with the magnetic strip at the correct distance.

codes.title: Main chiller error — no Modbus communication
codes.description: Communication with the main chiller cannot be established.
codes.cause: Chiller is off, the cable is disconnected or damaged, or Modbus configuration is incorrect.
remediation: Reset the chiller's thermal protection.
Connect the Modbus data cable to the chiller and enable Modbus control mode.
Ensure the terminating resistor is activated on the last chiller and the address is correct.
Replace the chiller data cables (external then internal), then the chiller, then the Master Controller board.

codes.title: Main chiller alarm active
codes.description: The main chiller has detected an internal condition that triggered an alarm.
codes.cause: Overheating, low refrigerant, defective components, or overpressure in the system.
remediation: Verify refrigerant flow and check for blockages.
Inspect the condenser for proper functioning and unobstructed fins.
Ensure condenser fans are operating optimally.
Check refrigerant levels and refill if necessary.

codes.title: Analog flow too low
codes.description: Coolant flow from the main chiller (analog sensor) is below 8 L/min and insufficient for safe operation.
codes.cause: Chiller not operating correctly, obstruction, or low coolant level.
codes.engineAction: Disengages safety — halts all printing operations
remediation: Verify the chiller operates correctly and the sensor reads accurately.
Check for obstructions or low coolant levels.

codes.title: Machine control software not detected
codes.description: The control module does not detect the Meltio control software as active.
codes.cause: The Engine control software (PC) is not detected.
remediation: Open the Engine control software.
If it appears after a PCB/software update or restart, clear errors and continue.

codes.title: Head Control Unit not detected
codes.description: The control module does not detect the Head Control Unit (HCU) module as active.
codes.cause: HCU not powered/connected, firmware not loaded, or harness fault.
remediation: Check all cables and the head harness.
Ensure the HCU board is powered, connected, LEDs blinking, and firmware loaded.

codes.title: Laser current out of range
codes.description: Abnormal current consumption outside the ±0.8A range ({target}). The line may have no power, or the laser/cable is damaged.
codes.cause: Line has no power, or the laser diode or its cable is damaged.
remediation: Ensure the line has power.
Check the cable from the power supply to the diode.

codes.title: Dimming output out of range
codes.description: {target} current-control dimming output is out of range.
codes.cause: Damaged IDC cable between the LCU and the source-management PCBs, or an LCU fault.
remediation: Check the IDC cables between the Laser Control Unit and the source management PCBs.
Replace the Laser Control Unit module if needed.

codes.title: Process control recovery failed
codes.description: The process control system failed to recover the print — no base/head continuity for more than 5 seconds.
codes.cause: Material depletion, feeder jamming/malfunction, nozzle clogging, or misconfigured process control type.
remediation: Verify there is material on the spool and the feeder is not jammed.
Confirm the ground reference is connected to the printing base.
Check that the load resistor is properly connected on the HCU board.

codes.title: Laser over-temperature detected
codes.description: The temperature detected in {target} exceeds 70°C.
codes.cause: Cooling insufficient, bypass open, circuit blockage, damaged diode, or dirty lenses.
remediation: Check the chiller operates correctly and the bypass is closed.
Ensure there are no blockages in the chiller circuit.
Confirm the diode is not damaged and the lenses are clean.

codes.title: Laser temperature sensor fault — open circuit
codes.description: The temperature sensor in {target} is disconnected or has an open circuit.
codes.cause: Loose IDC cable (Blue Ring ↔ HCU), laser not connected to the Blue Ring, or loose laser connector.
remediation: Check the IDC cable between the Blue Ring and the HCU.
Confirm the laser is connected to the Blue Ring and its connector is secure.

codes.title: Extruder motor error
codes.description: The {target} feeder motor has entered alarm mode or is disconnected.
codes.cause: Material jam/knot, or motor not powered / data cable disconnected / 75V supply fault.
remediation: Check material is not jammed and there are no knots on the spool.
Ensure the motor is powered, the data cable connected, and the 75V supply working.

codes.title: Head collision detected
codes.description: Electrical continuity between the head and the printing base was detected while lasers were disabled and safety was active.
codes.cause: Head contacting the base with lasers disabled; retraction distance too short or pulley tension off.
remediation: Avoid head-to-base contact when lasers are disabled.
Check the retraction distance and pulley tension.

codes.title: Broken protection glass detected
codes.description: The head's protective glass has been detected as broken (cover glass sensor open).
codes.cause: Protective glass broken or collision sensor disconnected.
remediation: Replace the protective glass.
Check the collision sensor connection.

codes.title: Argon flow did not reach target
codes.description: Argon flow deviated from target by more than 3 L/min for the past minute.
codes.cause: Depleted inert gas block/cylinder or insufficient supply pressure.
remediation: Replace the inert gas block or cylinder.
Increase supply line pressure to a minimum of 4 bar.

codes.title: Oxygen sensor 0–1000 ppm error
codes.description: 0–1000 ppm oxygen sensor: {target}.
codes.cause: No / invalid Modbus communication with the SEnz-Tx 0–1000 ppm precision oxygen sensor.
remediation: Check the connection between the Inert Bubble Control Unit and the 0–1000 ppm oxygen sensor.

codes.title: Differential pressure sensor error
codes.description: No communication with the differential pressure sensor.
codes.cause: Sensor communication lost.
remediation: Restart the Inert Bubble Control Unit.
If the issue persists, replace the IGC PCB.

codes.title: Safety line opened in integration
codes.description: The safety line is open due to external factors in the integration.
codes.cause: External integration factor opened the safety line.
codes.engineAction: Stops operations until the line is closed.
remediation: Investigate the integration setup for safety-line issues.

codes.title: Safety line opened by local E-stop
codes.description: The safety line was opened by the local emergency-stop button.
codes.cause: Emergency stop engaged locally.
codes.engineAction: Verify emergency conditions and reset as needed.
remediation: Confirm local safety before re-engaging the system.

codes.title: Control unit temperature out of range
codes.description: Control unit overheating > 50°C. Fan automatically started at maximum power.
codes.cause: Internal control-unit temperature sensor exceeded 50°C.
codes.engineAction: Fan activated to prevent further heating.
remediation: Monitor the control unit and consider external cooling measures.

codes.title: Extraction fan error
codes.description: Extraction fan: {target}.
codes.cause: Fan driver circuitry issue or a fan not present / not working.
codes.engineAction: Fans may default to maximum power.
remediation: Check fan wiring, power and presence.
Repair or replace the fan or its driver; replace the ECU if the driver is missing.

codes.title: Head collision detected but ignored
codes.description: A head collision with the base was detected, but collision prevention is currently disabled.
codes.cause: Collision prevention system disabled.
remediation: Ensure this setting is intentional.
Enable collision prevention to ensure safe operation.

codes.title: Argon pressure too low
codes.description: Argon input pressure is below 2 bar.
codes.cause: Low argon supply pressure.
remediation: Check the supply line and increase pressure if possible.

codes.title: Inert bubble overpressure detected
codes.description: Internal pressure exceeds 100 Pa (upper safety threshold).
codes.cause: Exhaust obstruction or pressure-regulation issue.
codes.engineAction: Reduces argon flow to 20 L/min (or stops it), and stops the air inlet if active.
remediation: Check for obstructions in the exhaust outlet or pressure regulation.
Ensure the outlet valve operates correctly.
Adjust argon flow settings if necessary.
